in_marathi.name: Architha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Architha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The goddess of knowledge and wisdom, Architha, is revered for her immense intelligence and her ability to bestow knowledge upon her followers. She is also known as the goddess of learning, and is often depicted with a book or a rosary in her hands.
